annotations.title: Get results of a longer job search

description: Fetch the results of a company_jobs, search_jobs or remote_jobs call that returned a run_id because it took longer than about two minutes. Returns the status while it is still running. Free: the original run is billed.

include_descriptions.description: Include the first 1,500 characters of each description as plain text (default false). Not billed extra.

limit.description: Jobs to return (default all, up to 55).

run_id.description: The run_id from the earlier call.

name: get_results
title: Get results of a longer job search
